    ✨ WHAT'S NEW IN TIGERBEATS ARMACO EDITION V9.4

    1. Real Stem-Sum Bus & Full Mixer Console

    Rebuilt graph with 4 parallel stem filter paths wired to dedicated GainNodes (setTargetAtTime(v, now, 0.02)), per-stem −60 to +12 dB faders, Multi-Solo, Mute, Pan, peak-hold VU meters, and Master L/R VU + LUFS.

    2. 4× Oversampled True-Peak Limiter (−1.0 dBTP)

    Custom AudioWorklet with 2 ms lookahead, 4× windowed-sinc inter-sample peak detection, ~50 ms smooth release, and 16-bit TPDF dither. All Math.tanh soft-clip stages removed.

    3. Honest Naming & Transparent Tooltips

    Renamed to "4-Band Filter Split (approximate, not source separation)" and "Curated DSP Presets". Every control documents its exact DSP stage.

    4. Sample-Rate Selector (44.1k / 48k / 96k)

    Switch project & render sample rates up to 96 kHz (strictly capped at 96 kHz to prevent 192 kHz browser OOM, with >500 MB RAM warning).

    5. Real ITU-R BS.1770-4 LUFS Metering Worklet

    MeterTap AudioWorklet computes K-weighted integrated & momentary LUFS, 4× true peak (dBTP), stereo phase correlation, and RMS.

    6. Memory Cap & Built-In 48 kHz Null Test

    Undo history capped at 3 ArrayBuffer snapshots with live RAM telemetry in MB, plus a one-click 48 kHz Real-Time vs. Offline Null Test (target ≤ −70 dBFS) and Automated Smoke Test.

    🛡️ Armaco EarGuard™ — Real-Time DSP Hearing & Call Protection

    🎧 Audio Output: Scanning Bluetooth / Wired Earphones…

    Safe ≤85dB · 00:00m
    • 1. Hearing Protection Ceiling: Smoothly limits sustained peak output (≤ 85 dB SPL equivalent ceiling) on Bluetooth and wired earphones.
    • 2. Call Safety: Automatically ducks or pauses audio (−24 dB smooth ramp) on incoming or active phone calls (AUDIOFOCUS_LOSS_TRANSIENT).
    • 3. Notification Safety: Smoothly attenuates sudden notification spikes and transient alerts (AUDIOFOCUS_LOSS_TRANSIENT_CAN_DUCK) so loud notification chimes never blast into earphones.
